module: Defines global constants identifying the input filter type (keyboard, gamepad, direct, drift keyboard, AI) and the FILTER_NAME table that gives a readable name. Useful when reading or sending input events (input.event) with a filter.
notes: A filter equal to -1 can be sent by the C++: it is guessed and translated engine-side into a filter >= 0 before reaching Lua (code comment).
FILTER_AI is the string "FILTER_AI" (not a number) and has no entry in FILTER_NAME.

FILTER_KBD2.desc: Global, equals 3: keyboard in drift mode (name "KeyboardDrift").

FILTER_AI.desc: Global, equals "FILTER_AI": filter used by the AI.

FILTER_NAME.desc: Global: readable name of each numeric filter (Keyboard, Gamepad, Direct, KeyboardDrift).
